name: berrydev-skills
description: Claude Code marketplace adapter for Berry Development's portable Agent Skills. Each skill installs as an independent plugin.

plugins.name: issue-readiness
plugins.description: Assess whether a GitHub issue is ready to implement — checks goal, testable acceptance criteria, scope, and context, then drafts the missing sections.

plugins.name: mastra-api-cli
plugins.description: Inspect and operate Mastra servers through the `mastra api` CLI — agents, workflows, tools, MCP, memory, and observability.

plugins.name: pr-description
plugins.description: Generate or revise pull request and merge request descriptions from branch, diff, commit, issue, and repository evidence.

plugins.name: sync-with-primary
plugins.description: Sync the repository's primary branch (main/master/default) to local, then merge it into the current branch. Auto-detects primary, auto-stashes uncommitted work, and merges (never rebases or force-pushes).

plugins.name: use-orchestration
plugins.description: Plan, coordinate, execute, and verify non-trivial engineering work with task tracking, focused subagents, autonomous debugging, and correction-driven lessons.
